Thank you to everyone that assisted in testing! 🫂 

Although you won't see it in this version, we're nearly done with the stage editor and are actively testing to get it ready for the 1.0 launch. Part of the goal of today's patch is to ensure that the new code is stable (since the stage editor development has impacted everything from the editing tools to online multiplayer!)

notes.title: Smack Studio is ONLINE!
notes.content:
[b]Smack Studio Online is here![/b]
After months of testing and working to perfect our rollback netcode, we finally feel that we’re in a place to open up online play to the public with a beta release!  

Both online and offline, we have a 2-frame delay in-game (roughly the same as Super Smash Bros. Melee and Slippi online). That’s 3x faster than Super Smash Bros. Ultimate's 6-frame delay offline, and 5x faster than Ultimate's online (11-fame delay [i]minimum[/i]).  

You can play with up to 4 people in a session, whether it’s a free for all or a team battle, and each player can customize their input delay. So if 3 players are on the WC server, and one is in the EU server, they can all have the same experience with customized input delay.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182060/83ec4a0d7d32353e1973fa856404ce91f9fad8ee.gif[/img]

[h3]As an added surprise, our online beta is also launching with 3 new stages:[/h3]

🍄 Mushroom Heights
🌇 Neon Metro
🌄 Highland Ruins

⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182060/45797d90e08567b8c31818bef33503f2f73df97d.gif[/img]

There are nearly 800 playable fighters in our Steam Workshop, so don’t forget to browse the workshop for characters before heading online. 

⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182060/de1b2cb303aded03878afdcbed3d9532c0de41e8.gif[/img]

[h2]Online Play FAQ:[/h2]

[u]Do workshop characters work online?[/u]

Yes! When a player in your session selects a workshop character that you haven't downloaded, it temporarily downloads the character the second your opponent selects it.  

[u]Is this a full release for online?[/u]
Our online play is still in beta and some bumps still need to be ironed out. With a larger player base, we hope to find bugs and causes of desyncs much faster to make any necessary changes (if needed) for our 1.0 launch.  

[u]Can I play a character online that I haven’t uploaded to the workshop?[/u]

No, the only way you can play characters online is if they have been uploaded to the workshop. This helps us maintain version control and fight against desyncs and crashes.  


[u]What if characters are extremely overpowered? [/u]

Since the power of a character is determined by its creator, characters can be extremely OP. When you create a session, you can decide if workshop characters are allowed. In the future we’d like to implement “collections” of characters, so online sessions will have “workshop collections,” and only characters within that collection can be played.   

[u]How can I find a game?[/u]

You can see a full list of sessions around the world, so in most cases you can find a match quickly. To voice chat with other players or find matches, join our [url=https://discord.gg/e6p5vH24dC]Discord[/url] and grab the Matchmaking role!

notes.title: Smack Studio Beta Release
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce the launch of a new, polished beta version!

Major changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Character balance and moveset refresh:[/b] Every character on the roster has received improvements across the board. New moves, tweaked parameters, balancing, new animations, and sprite art.
[*] [b]New animations:[/b] every character now has an entrance and victory animation. If none is defined, it will default to idle.
[*] [b]Victory screen:[/b] bask in your glory with a brand-new victory screen.
[*] [b]Game optimization:[/b] with a version upgrade to Unreal Engine, we’ve drastically improved performance for all users.
[*] [b]New stages and art style:[/b] we’ve polished our stages and are bringing you five remastered versions in our new art style. There might be an additional hidden stage available to play if you can find it…
[*] [b]Enhanced visuals:[/b] check out our new lighting engine and enable motion blur with the new “epic” visual setting.
[*] [b]New soundtrack:[/b] enjoy music tracks tailor-made for Smack Studio by Garrett Williamson with additional tracks by Argofox. This includes optional music for both the character editor and training mode, plus a brand-new victory theme.
[*] [b]Audio and sound:[/b] new in-game announcer (featuring the voice talents of Lunchbillion), improved music looping, and volume levels across the board.
[*] [b]New menus and polish:[/b] enjoy a new stage select screen, new screen transitions, and a new adjustable character editor background.
[*] [b]Controller profile improvements:[/b] we’ve allowed saved controller profiles to be universal, meaning additional controllers of the same kind will automatically match to an existing controller profile if it exists.
[*] [b]Fighting game engine:[/b] short inactive frames added to ledge grab, and disallow midair jumps or air dodging back to players who get hit. Improves game balance.
[*] [b]CPU AI:[/b] increased intelligence of computer-controlled fighters, allowing them to execute wavedashing and not grabbing the ledge as often.
[*] [b]Bug fixes:[/b] super armor is now functional, portrait fixes for workshop characters, sound bug fixes, and a whole host of character editor bugs are fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Smack Studio Character Updates + New Fighter Spry
notes.content:
[b]New Fighter: Spry[/b]
[list]
[*] Captain Jessica "Spry" Coney is an energetic, loose cannon sharpshooter from a distant planet. 
[*] Gameplay-wise, she's what you'd expect from a platform fighting space animal... but with some new tricks as well!
[*] Special attacks: blaster, sticky grenade, gravity lift, reflector
[*] All of Spry's special moves have some unique utilities and mixup options which we'll cover in detail in future posts. Make sure you're [url=https://twitter.com/SmackStudio]following us on Twitter[/url] for the latest updates!
[/list].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182060/a815e8c506495d366ae438d55ef6fa4f1fe50c6b.png[/img]

[b]Base Roster Fighter Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Across the board, our base roster has received balance changes, animation tweaks, and sprite polish. 
[*] On the backend, we've also included comments so you can see exactly how the actions are set up- perfect for learning how to create more advanced functionality for your own characters!
[/list]
[b]Gameplay updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added option to jump out of shield and shield drop (dropping through a platform by pressing down as you come out of shield)
[*] Added B-reverse (pressing the opposite direction immediately after neutral B attack to turn around instantly)
[/list]
[b]Performance updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Hugely reduced load times when entering a match in Battle mode
[*] Hugely reduce load times when entering Test Play in the character editor
[/list]
[b]Character editor enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added option to create a character from a template. Template characters are white to allow easily drawing your own details over the default images.
[*] Added option to create a new, empty character
[*] Added the ability to add comments and line breaks to organize frame actions (and all of our standard characters are commented to help you learn from our work!)
[*] Added the ability to edit custom variable descriptions to help with organization
[*] Added Else and Else If statements to organize code flow, used  with the If statements that already existed
[*] Added new variables for use in frame actions: Lives, Damage, Ultra Fill, Velocity X, Velocity Y
[*] Added new function: Set Temporary Character Properties (used to temporarily boost speed and other stats during an animation)
[*] New parameter in Set Temporary Air/Ground Settings: "Allow attack out of animation" (used for attacks that should be cancellable into other attacks- like Spry's new Up B attack)
[*] Added new frame actions to control projectile movement: Move In X/Y Direction, Set Horizontal Movement Velocity, Set Vertical Movement Velocity, Set Movement Velocity To Zero, Set Movement Velocity In Direction, Set Movement Velocity Using Input Direction
[*] Added projectile settings: DestroyOnHittingPlayer, StickOnHittingPlayer
[*] Added size setting in projectile properties
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The list of available 3D effects was limited in projectiles and didn't match the choices in a regular character animation
[*] No ability to preview 3D effects in projectile frame actions
[*] In a rare scenario, projectile data can be copied between projectiles while in Test Play
[*] Added setting to avoid destroying projectile when hitting opponent
[*] Effect layers don't get palette swapped
[*] After converting a sprite to an effect layer, mouse position is incorrect when drawing
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch notes 12/5/21
notes.content:
In this patch we did a huge amount of future-proofing, and introduced some important quality of life features. We'll be releasing another update soon where we leverage all of these updates in our own standard characters!

[b]Enable and disable animations in the editor[/b]
[list]
[*] Click the check box next to any animation to toggle its enabled status.
[*] Disable animations that aren't finished yet, and you can play the character without fear of getting locked in place or triggering a bug.
[*] You can now enable the "B" and "Down B" animations in your own characters. We'll release these animations in the standard characters soon!
[/list]

[b]Animation-specific events[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now add events in the Events pane that will apply only to the current animation, allowing for greater flexibility.
[*] Example: When our attack hits an opponent, play an animation- but only if we're using our Side B attack!
[/list]

[b]New system to easily customize physics for attacks[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new frame actions: [b]Set Temporary Air Control Settings[/b] and [b]Set Temporary Ground Control Settings[/b]
[*] These actions have a list of optional parameters. Enable the ones you need, and the rest of the settings are left at their default values.
[*] Settings are reset when your animation ends or is interrupted, so change settings without fear of breaking your other functionality.
[*] Easily create attacks that hover, move your character on a path, have custom landing behavior, etc.
[*] [b]Note: we removed the "PhysicsEnabled" variable, because it was causing bugs. This new system is a much more flexible replacement![/b]
[/list]

[b]New system for easier combo creation[/b]
[list]
[*] Add the frame action "Start Input Listener" and tell it which input to listen for (for example, [i]Press Attack[/i])
[*] Add child actions, like you would in an If statement, and they will be executed when the input is detected.
[*] No more copying If statements onto every frame to check for inputs!
[/list]

[b]Added a single platform stage[/b]
[list]
[*] We've gotten a lot of requests for a stage like Final Destination. We rigged up a simple one that you can play on for now.
[*] More updates to stages coming in future updates!
[/list]

[b]Other small character editor enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Frame actions can now set movement speeds higher than the player's walk/run speed (previously, the speeds were capped)
[*] New events: Got Shielded, Move Into Wall
[*] Added settings to customize hitstun for hitboxes
[*] New frame actions for easier movement control: [b]Set Zero Movement Speed[/b] and [b]Set Movement Speed In Direction[/b].
[*] Standardized landing animations: the Land animation will play any time you land, unless you override with custom landing behavior in a given animation. If you don't want this behavior, you can disable the Land animation.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changing a profile picture isn't saved unless the file name is changed when saving.
[*] When renaming a custom variable, occurrences of the variable in frame events were not renamed.
[*] Flipping imported sprites can result in unwanted cropping.
[*] Visual bugs occur if you exit Test Play while shielding.
[*] Unable to scroll the list of sprites in the Animation Rig Details pane in order to add more to the list.
[/list]

notes.title: Smack Studio soft launch, happening now
notes.content:

We're aware of some issues with controller support (and even occasional crashes on startup!) that people are having when trying to launch the game, and we're working to get those resolved as quickly as we can. 

We'd love to hear from you if you're having issues playing the game, and we'll do our best to resolve problems quickly. Ways you can contact us:
- Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/kJYgQP8G
- Find us on Twitter: @SmackStudio
- Email us: contact@smackstudio.com

We'll send out more news as there are further developments about our launch!

-The Smack Studio team
